atomicityCandidate.reason: Both independent rounds call for splitting. n and k are discrete unknowns with different event constraints; p is a real-valued parameter and may have multiple admissible solutions. The current description does not specify point, interval, or cumulative probability form.
suggestedSplit: Given p and a specified event condition, determine an unknown trial count n and check the integer solution in context.
Given n and a specified event condition, determine admissible success-probability values p with an appropriate tool and check all solutions in context.
Given n, p, and a specified point, interval, or cumulative target, determine the event boundary k and interpret the discrete boundary in context.
